component.name: Emobie
component.summary: Compact emoji palette for content creators

description.p: Emobie is a compact Linux-first emoji palette for content creators. Browse the full Unicode emoji set, favorite what you use most, copy with one click, pin above other windows, and summon Emobie with a global hotkey or the system tray.
Resize freely between horizontal, square, and vertical layouts. Preferences cover theme, emoji size, skin tone, recent history, and hotkey binding.
Fix Flatpak startup crash by bundling Ayatana AppIndicator for the system tray.
Migrate Flatpak runtime to supported GNOME Platform 50.

ul.li: Full Unicode emoji catalog with categories, search, and skin tones
Favorites via right-click, plus recent emoji history
Always-on-top pin, system tray, and global hotkey toggle
Adaptive compact layouts and light/dark/system themes
Flatpak packaging and GitHub release workflow
